_contract.what: The Looks Sam can pick for a clip. One source of truth: jobs/cut.py renders these, worker/domain/looks.ts mirrors them (tests/unit/looks.test.ts fails if the two disagree), and the validator `looks` fails on a Look without a description, a thumbnail (public/looks/<id>.webp) or test coverage.
_contract.captions: clean = white words at the bottom (or centre), no highlight | karaoke = centred, the spoken word lights up in the brand colour | boxed = words on a brand-coloured box | none
_contract.hook: top_bold = big bold hook text at the top for the first 2.5 s | none
_contract.layout: fill = full-frame 9:16, crop follows the face | blur_fill = the whole frame over a blurred copy of itself (landscape sources keep everything) | pip = full frame plus a small inset replaying the strongest line | grid = the cells in `grid`, each its own moment, one of them the voice
_contract.grid: a key of `grids`: cells are [x, y, w, h] in the 1080x1920 frame, even numbers, 12 px paper-coloured gutters between cells
_contract.punch_in: a subtle zoom on every other sentence start
_contract.progress_bar: a thin brand-coloured bar along the bottom that fills as the clip plays
_contract.crossfade: smooth crossfades between the moments inside a clip, and a short fade in from black
_contract.grade: none | warm (a gentle warm, filmic colour grade with a soft vignette)
_contract.end_card: her logo and handle for the last 1.5 s (Settings > Editing can switch every end card off)
_contract.music: never per Look: the music bed plays only her own uploaded songs (Settings > Editing > My music), under her voice

looks.name: Clean
looks.description: Full frame that follows your face, simple white captions at the bottom, your end card.

looks.name: Bold hook
looks.description: Big bold hook across the top for the first seconds, each word lights up as you say it, a little zoom on each new sentence.

looks.name: Karaoke captions
looks.description: Captions in the middle of the screen, each word lights up as you say it, with a progress bar.

looks.name: Brand card
looks.description: Captions on a box in your brand colour, a brand-coloured progress bar and your logo card at the end.

looks.name: Cinematic
looks.description: The whole picture over a soft blurred copy, a warm film look, smooth fades between moments.

looks.name: Reaction inset
looks.description: Full frame with your strongest line replaying in a small window in the corner.

looks.name: Split moment
looks.description: Two moments stacked, top and bottom. You hear the top one; captions sit on the line between.

looks.name: Side by side
looks.description: Two moments next to each other, left and right, like a before and after.

looks.name: Grid of four
looks.description: Four moments in a 2 by 2 grid. One plays its sound; you can change which one in Review.

looks.name: Grid of six
looks.description: Six moments in a 2 by 3 grid, great for a recap of your week.

looks.name: Grid of eight
looks.description: Eight moments in a 2 by 4 grid, a busy montage with one voice on top.

looks.name: Hero and strip
looks.description: One big moment on top and three small ones in a strip underneath.
